stops.name: Parco del Serio
stops.detail: The park of the Serio is a protected natural area of Lombardy that develops along the Serio river to its mouth in the Adda from the municipality of Seriate to the municipality of Montodine, for a length of about 45 km. The territory of the park crosses 26 municipalities between the province of Bergamo and Cremona. The total area is 7750 hectares and is between a minimum of 48 m a.s.l. and 250 m s.l. The reasons that led to the establishment of the park were the preservation of the typical perifluvial environment, favoring its recovery and avoiding its degradation.
